morbi.headline: Morbi faces operational stress with unit shutdowns, high inventory, and rising fuel costs
what_changed: Morbi ceramic production cycle slowed down, resulting in full warehouses of unsold stock and 15% of units shutting down
Attempts to mitigate or control elevated propane gas prices have failed, increasing operational challenges
Proposed ceramic testing laboratory for Bikaner's 200 clay mines is being relocated to Jaipur due to building possession delays
stress_signals: 15% of ceramic manufacturing units have shut down due to high inventory and production slowdowns [64076d83f199]
Rising propane gas prices remain uncontrolled, straining operational costs for cluster units [64076d83f199]
what_to_watch: Inventory liquidation trends and warehouse stock levels across ceramic manufacturing accounts
Propane gas price movements and impact on unit-level operating margins and debt serviceability
Operational continuity and capacity utilization metrics to identify further potential unit closures

surat.headline: Severe textile labor and input stress contrasts with reviving diamond sector demand.
what_changed: Textile and weaving units face acute labor shortages from strikes, agitations, and migrant worker exodus ahead of Diwali.
Upstream textile costs surged via a 66% yarn price hike, paired with mandatory 15-day yarn payment rules.
Diamond manufacturers are cutting Diwali vacation lengths and seeing resurgence in demand, contrasting with pre-festive textile recession.
stress_signals: Surat textile industry faces shutdown risks following a steep 66% surge in yarn prices [b62552cc0c7d] alongside pre-Diwali recessionary conditions [28ff6df05700].
Weavers are instituting weekly two-day holidays amid tightened 15-day mandatory yarn payment terms [0c72a246c955].
Widespread labor unrest, including strikes, 'Gaon Chalo' protests, embroidery worker agitations, and reverse migration to UP and Bihar [d6a4b0e6a74b, 73dfcce5d3f4, a9383cbae2cf, 6b7974c7f88e].
Elevated credit and counterparty risks highlighted by a Rs 15.57 crore textile fraud arrest [cf2229091691] and four multi-crore cheating cases across yarn, fabric, and diamonds [2718cba9f837].
improvement_signals: Surat diamond industry shortened Diwali vacations for the first time in four years due to improved demand and wage restoration hopes [2b47ff4fa01a, ff0f473e0921].
Institutional infrastructure expansion with ICA-GemLab opening its first Indian testing laboratory in Surat [26bd1ecd549c] and MANTRA positioning Surat as a testing hub [0b9a805766c6].
Niche technological milestone achieved with a Surat-made fabric-coated surveillance airship tested at 21 km altitude [5a6c6ad01d9d].
what_to_watch: Capacity utilization and working capital stretch in weaving units managing 15-day yarn settlement rules amid margin compression.
Impact of migrant labor depletion and worker agitations on post-festive production schedules across weaving and embroidery mills.
Compliance and inventory disclosures following mandatory return filings on the Textile Statistical Returns System (TSRS) portal.
